title: Psalms Bible Quiz - Chapter 66
description: Ten questions on Psalms 66: a joyful shout from all the earth, the sea turned into dry land, people refined like silver, and vows paid in the temple.

questions.text: Who is called to make a joyful shout to God in verse 1?
questions.explanation: Psalms 66:1 says, "Make a joyful shout to God, all the earth!"

questions.text: Through the greatness of God's power, what do his enemies do?
questions.explanation: Psalms 66:3 says that through the greatness of God's power his enemies submit themselves to him.

questions.text: Into what did God turn the sea, according to verse 6?
questions.explanation: Psalms 66:6 says, "He turned the sea into dry land."

questions.text: How did they go through the river in verse 6?
questions.explanation: Psalms 66:6 says, "They went through the river on foot."

questions.text: As what does verse 10 say God has refined his people?
questions.explanation: Psalms 66:10 says, "You have refined us, as silver is refined."

questions.text: After fire and water, where did God bring his people?
questions.explanation: Psalms 66:12 says, "We went through fire and through water, but you brought us to the place of abundance."

answers.text: To the top of the mountain
To the shore of the sea

questions.text: With what will the psalmist come into God's temple, according to verse 13?
questions.explanation: Psalms 66:13 says, "I will come into your temple with burnt offerings."

questions.text: Which animals are named in the offerings of verse 15?
questions.explanation: Psalms 66:15 speaks of the offering of rams and says, "I will offer bulls with goats."

questions.text: What would have happened if the psalmist had cherished sin in his heart?
questions.explanation: Psalms 66:18 says, "If I cherished sin in my heart, the Lord wouldn't have listened."

answers.text: He would have lost his land
His vows would have been broken

questions.text: What has God not turned away, according to the last verse?
questions.explanation: Psalms 66:20 says, "Blessed be God, who has not turned away my prayer."
